touches.text: artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). WHY: errors are permanent in records of truth (Law 7), and the journal is what shows a record moved by hand. USERS: everyone who writes a record.

The one writer question is LLM or code, and only for gate-pass certificates; who authored a write is not tracked otherwise. So on Windows the caller class comes from the process chain: claude.exe above the writer means cc; otherwise it is not cc. Env vars are a fallback only. Certificates are made where the sealer runs (9.4.2.3.3.1), so Windows does not need a gate class of its own. - CC

CC over ssh is told from Akien by the key sshd accepted: CC on each box gets a dedicated ssh key. Until it lands, approve and the operator close refuse any sshd-session caller, Akien's included (Q#115). -amm
